name: postfader-fl-studio-mcp
description: AI copilot for FL Studio project understanding, mixing, plug-ins, composition, and arrangement.
long_description: A local 127-tool MCP server and MIDI bridge that lets an AI inspect and control the open FL Studio project, run bounded task-scoped Production Runs, review exported creation bounces with 13 Creation Review tools and 9 corresponding run operations, plan one bounded revision, prepare delivery handoffs, diagnose exported mixes, work with loaded plug-ins, compose deterministic parts, export multi-track MIDI, and prepare Piano Roll transforms. PostFader starts read-only, never saves the project automatically, and reads supported direct changes back from FL Studio. Before opening this extension, install the matching Python package and run `postfader setup`; the .mcpb does not deploy FL Studio's controller script or configure a virtual MIDI endpoint.

midi_port.title: Virtual MIDI endpoint
midi_port.description: Exact endpoint name shared with FL Studio. PostFader does not install or configure a virtual MIDI provider.

fl_studio_user_data_dir.title: FL Studio user-data directory
fl_studio_user_data_dir.description: Absolute path to the FL Studio user-data directory containing Settings/Hardware.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_pan

tools.name: fl_set_track_eq

tools.name: fl_set_plugin_param

tools.name: fl_apply_verified_batch

tools.name: fl_set_playing

tools.description: Stop playback, set normalized position to zero, and verify both fields.

tools.name: fl_set_metronome

tools.name: fl_set_precount

tools.name: plugins_inspect_pad_map

tools.description: Set pattern name and/or color with per-field later-tick proof.

tools.name: fl_list_playlist_tracks

tools.name: fl_set_playlist_track_identity
tools.description: Set Playlist name and/or color with per-field later-tick proof.

tools.name: fl_set_playlist_track_state

tools.name: fl_set_channel_mix

tools.name: fl_set_channel_solo

tools.name: fl_set_channel_pitch

tools.name: fl_select_channel
tools.description: Select one global channel exclusively and verify the complete selection.

tools.name: fl_set_channel_identity

tools.name: fl_route_channel_to_mixer

tools.name: fl_get_step_sequence
tools.description: Read an explicit current-pattern/channel grid and its conflict digest.

tools.name: fl_set_step_sequence

tools.description: Measure level, spectrum, dynamics, stereo, and optional pitch of one render.

tools.name: audio_compare_files

tools.name: audio_find_recent_bounces

tools.name: mix_inspect_plugin_compatibility

tools.name: mix_create_plan

tools.name: mix_get_plan

tools.name: mix_apply_plan
tools.description: Apply a plan once through the verified batch kernel.

tools.name: mix_finish_assessment
tools.description: Run the end-to-end read-only finish assessment and stop at user export.

tools.name: sound_selection_inventory

tools.name: sound_selection_plan

tools.name: sound_selection_get
tools.description: Look up one process-local palette without treating expiry as a server error.
